page_title: RBL 6-0 EIN | RB Leipzig v Eintracht Frankfurt 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+4' Samba Konate (RB Leipzig) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
90+3' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniel Siebert signals.
90+2' RB Leipzig players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Samba Konate (RB Leipzig) coming on for Yan Diomande.
85' The foul by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniel Siebert.
84' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
83' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniel Siebert stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
79' Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
78' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
75' The referee blows his whistle as Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in his challenge.
72' Today's match ends for Nicolas Seiwald who will be replaced by Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig).
69' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Nathaniel Brown and he is replaced by Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt).
68' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniel Siebert ignores the protests.
67' It is time for a substitution. Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) is on for Conrad Harder.
67' It will be a substitution. Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig) is ready to enter the pitch as Christoph Baumgartner walks off.
67' Here is a change. David Raum is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig).
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ritsu Doan walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
65' 6 - 0 Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) is released by Nicolas Seiwald, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
62' 5 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by David Raum (RB Leipzig) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Michael Zetterer no chance!
62' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
61' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) touches the ball with his hand. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for RB Leipzig.
61' The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
60' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
60' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
58' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
58' Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) serves up a nice cross, but Michael Zetterer punches the ball away.
56' Jean-Matteo Bahoya comes off the pitch to be replaced by Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt).
56' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud is replaced by Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt).
55' 4 - 0 Goal! Christoph Baumgartner slips it to Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 4:0.
53' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to David Raum (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
52' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!

51' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Peter Gulacsi pulls off an easy save.
50' What a chance that is! Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
47' 3 - 0 Goal! Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 3:0.
46' Dino Toppmoller is forced to make a change. Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Jessic Ngankam.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+3' Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45+2' David Raum (RB Leipzig) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
45+1' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
43' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) makes a strong challenge and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul.
41' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for RB Leipzig due to an offside in the build-up play.
40' Wait! Referee Daniel Siebert has indicated he is going to review the RB Leipzig goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
39' Goal! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Xaver Schlager. The score is 3:0.
38' The resulting corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is cleared by the defence.
38' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Good work from RB Leipzig as they win a corner.
33' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Daniel Siebert signals that the goal stands! The RB Leipzig players celebrate.
32' Wait! Referee Daniel Siebert has indicated he is going to review the RB Leipzig goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
31' 2 - 0 GOAL! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) runs onto a pass from Conrad Harder after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 2:0.
31' Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the bar!
31' The free kick into the penalty area from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.
30' David Raum (RB Leipzig) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The ratio of the ball possession is 50:50.
24' Daniel Siebert blows the whistle, Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for a foul.
23' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) brought his opponent down.
22' What a big chance! Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
20' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
19' Daniel Siebert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt).
18' A clumsy foul by Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle.
15' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
14' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Eintracht Frankfurt string together a series of short passes.
10' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

8' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Michael Zetterer keeps the ball out.
7' Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
5' 1 - 0 What a sweet header! Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) leaps high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box and scores with a trademark header.
3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Peter Gulacsi.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Eintracht Frankfurt will take the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert is the one to supervise the game today.
